ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-moderate; predominantly mid-range gray pixel values across the fluke surface with concentrated low-intensity (dark) pixels near the insertion point and high-intensity (white) specular highlights from water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray-to-black mottled blobs located at the central insertion/peduncle area; sparse white micro-pixel clusters distributed across the medial and distal sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-defined angle of approximately 75-85 degrees, exhibiting a deep incision relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (1-4 pixels) creating a jagged profile along the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a convex sweep towards the tip; right lobe displays a straighter, more elongated linear sweep ending in a slightly rounded tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring patterns on the lower-left quadrant and center-right of the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark pigmented irregular patches near the median notch and insertion point; visible white scarring on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive water-droplet occlusion across the ventral surface creates a pseudo-mottled high-contrast texture.
